condition.help: Fix total hydraulic head H = h + y on a boundary. Use it for a submerged face such as the upstream slope under a reservoir, where the total head is one constant but the pressure head varies with elevation. On export ADSIM converts it per node to pressure head h = H - y, so a single value covers the whole face at any mesh refinement. Give the elevation of the water surface, measured in the same datum as the geometry.

value.help: Total head in metres, referred to the same datum as the model geometry. For a reservoir this is the water surface elevation.
